candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory span errors at ~1050ms with 6 redis_operation_timeout 504 logs and 9 dependency_timeouts, driving inventory p95 to 760ms and gateway call-inventory errors; consistent with a Redis timeout on the inventory dependency path.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (latency, saturation, connection errors) is absent; timeout cause (load vs network vs config) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Inventory traces show an errored redis.reserve_inventory span (~1050ms) with matching redis_operation_timeout 504 logs and elevated dependency_timeouts and p95, propagating to gateway call-inventory errors. Gateway and order metrics remain healthy, and the inventory deployment record alone does not establish causation. Redis-side telemetry is missing, so the bounded candidate is a Redis timeout on the inventory path.
